name: Registro Imprese
description: Registro Imprese is the Italian business register held by the Chambers of Commerce, carrying company data, officers, shareholdings and filed financial statements. It is published online as the official data of the Chambers of Commerce, and the platform is run for them by their information-technology consortium.
bestFor: Confirming that an Italian business is on the statutory register and reading its recorded officers and shareholdings.
Reading financial statements an Italian company has filed.
notRecommendedFor: Treating the platform operator as the authority behind the register, which is the Chambers of Commerce.
Obtaining a certified extract without charge, because certified output is a paid chamber service.
pros: It is the statutory Italian business register, so an entry exists because of a filing rather than a submission.
Company data, officers, shareholdings and filed financial statements sit together in one system.
The register is published as the official data of the Chambers of Commerce rather than by a commercial reseller.
cons: Certified extracts and filed documents are a paid chamber service, and the pricing was not established.
Responsibility is distributed across the individual Chambers of Commerce rather than held by a single national office, so a question about a specific entry belongs to the chamber that holds it.
The platform is operated for the chambers by their information-technology consortium, which runs the service but is not the authority behind the register.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-04; operator corrected 2026-08-05 (Wave 1D). CORRECTION: operator.name previously read "InfoCamere, with the Italian Chambers of Commerce" with operator.type "other", which put the technical provider in front of the authority and typed a public-law register as though its operator were neither government nor regulator. The service publishes itself as the official data of the Chamber of Commerce, and the register is held by the Chambers of Commerce under Italian law; InfoCamere is the chambers’ own information-technology consortium and runs the platform for them. Operator is therefore the Italian Chambers of Commerce, typed public-law-body, and the consortium’s real technical role is recorded in prose rather than deleted. Registry types are unchanged: unlike the German, French and Spanish cases, this system genuinely is the constitutive register, so company-register and public-filing-database both remain correct. Score unchanged: only the attribution of the operator was wrong.

name: Banca dati UIBM
description: Banca dati UIBM is the searchable database of Italian industrial property titles published by the Italian Patent and Trademark Office within the enterprise ministry. It covers applications and granted titles for trade marks, patents and designs, which are three distinct rights recorded in one search system.
officialName: Banca dati dei titoli italiani di proprietà industriale
nativeName: Banca dati dei titoli italiani di proprietà industriale

operator.name: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy — Ufficio Italiano Brevetti e Marchi

publicAccess.notes: The database is searched without an account. A CAPTCHA control is present in the search form and is recorded as such rather than assumed absent.

bestFor: Checking whether an Italian trade mark, patent or design has been applied for or granted, and to whom.
Establishing the status of an Italian industrial property title before relying on it.
notRecommendedFor: Confirming that a company exists, which is the business register held by the Chambers of Commerce.
Clearing a mark on its own, because rights arising outside the Italian register are not recorded here.
recommendedIndustries: Holders and applicants of Italian industrial property titles
pros: Three separate industrial property rights — trade marks, patents and designs — are searchable from one official government database.
It is published by the office that grants the titles, within the enterprise ministry, rather than by a commercial republisher.
Searching is free and needs no account.
cons: A CAPTCHA control is present in the search form, so automated or bulk consultation is constrained.
It records industrial property titles, not businesses. An entry establishes nothing about whether the holder is a registered or solvent company.
Rights that arise without registration are not recorded here, so an empty result is not a clearance opinion.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-05 from official Italian sources. FOUR ROLES, determined separately. LEGAL SOURCE OF RECORD: Italian industrial property titles are granted and registered by the Italian Patent and Trademark Office under the industrial property code; the database publishes those registered titles. The article-level provision was not fetched and is therefore not cited. RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy, through its industrial property directorate-general and the Italian Patent and Trademark Office. TECHNICAL PLATFORM: Not separately identified from any official page fetched. PUBLIC ACCESS INTERFACE: The public database at uibm.gov.it/bancadati. A CAPTCHA control was found in the search form during verification and is recorded as present; an earlier draft asserting that no CAPTCHA existed was corrected before publication. This record uses registered-design-register, which was added in an earlier wave for a verified future need and had no records until now.

name: Piattaforma per la pubblicità a valore legale
description: Piattaforma per la pubblicità a valore legale is the Italian platform on which public procurement notices are published with legal effect, operated by the national anti-corruption authority. Since January 2024 it has replaced the special public-contracts series of the official gazette for national procurement publication, and the legal effects of a published notice run from its publication there.
nativeName: Piattaforma per la pubblicità a valore legale

publicAccess.notes: The interface is client-rendered, but its public query endpoints returned notice records and full notice content anonymously from outside Italy, with no credential, no challenge and no charge, which is how the access position was established rather than inferred.

bestFor: Finding Italian public procurement notices at the point where their legal effects begin.
Establishing whether and when a given Italian procurement notice was published with legal effect.
notRecommendedFor: Checking whether a supplier exists or is eligible, which a notice platform does not record.
European-level publication, which runs through the EU channel rather than this national platform.
recommendedIndustries: Suppliers to Italian public sector bodies
pros: Publication here is what produces the legal effects of an Italian procurement notice, so the platform is part of the procedure rather than a report on it.
It replaced the special public-contracts series of the official gazette for national publication from January 2024, consolidating a function that was previously split.
Notices are searched and read free of charge without an account, which was confirmed by anonymous retrieval rather than assumed.
cons: It is a notice platform, not a supplier register. Publication of a notice establishes nothing about any supplier’s eligibility, standing or trustworthiness.
It is the publicly searchable legal-publicity component of a wider national procurement database, which is not itself publicly searchable as a whole.
It covers national publication. European-level publication of the same procurement runs through a separate channel.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-05 from official Italian sources, including the public contracts code and the authority’s own service pages. FOUR ROLES, determined separately. LEGAL SOURCE OF RECORD: The Banca dati nazionale dei contratti pubblici is the statutory locus of procurement publicity under the public contracts code: publication there is what produces the legal effects of a notice. This platform is the publicly accessible legal-publicity component of that database, and from 1 January 2024 it replaced the official gazette special series for national publication. RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY: Autorità Nazionale Anticorruzione, which operates the platform; the implementing measure under the code was adopted by the authority in agreement with the infrastructure and transport ministry. TECHNICAL PLATFORM: Unknown. No official page fetched names the software supplier of the platform application. PUBLIC ACCESS INTERFACE: The public platform at pubblicitalegale.anticorruzione.it. An earlier draft framed the national procurement database as merely an interoperability layer and this platform as a register in its own right; that was inverted before publication, because the code makes the database the locus of legally effective publication and this platform its public surface. The English name is the authority’s own published English rendering rather than an editorial translation.

name: Registro Unico Nazionale del Terzo Settore
description: The Registro unico nazionale del Terzo settore is the Italian register of third sector entities, established at the Ministry of Labour and Social Policies under the Third Sector Code. Registration confers the status of third sector entity and, where applicable, the specific statuses of voluntary organisation, social promotion association, philanthropic entity or associative network.
officialName: Registro unico nazionale del Terzo settore
nativeName: Registro unico nazionale del Terzo settore
englishName: National Single Register of the Third Sector

operator.name: Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali

publicAccess.notes: The portal states that the register is public and consultable by all interested parties and by public administrations, and its entity search and downloadable entity lists are reachable from the public navigation without an account. Filing and management functions are behind a separate authenticated area, which was not exercised. No CAPTCHA was encountered, but absence was not established and none is asserted.

bestFor: Confirming that an Italian organisation is a registered third sector entity and which specific status it holds.
Checking eligibility signals that depend on registration, such as access to the five per thousand scheme or agreements with public administrations.
notRecommendedFor: Company verification. Commercial entities are registered in the business register, not here.
Treating registration as a statement about how an organisation is run or how it spends its funds.
pros: Registration is constitutive of third sector status: the portal states that entities not registered may not use the designation of third sector entity or the specific ones.
The register is expressly public and consultable by all interested parties, with both an entity search and downloadable entity lists.
One national register replaces the separate sectoral registers that previously governed voluntary organisations and social promotion associations.
cons: Registration is administered on a territorial basis across the state, regional and provincial offices of the register, so practice and processing sit with different offices rather than one desk.
The public view records registration and status. It is not an account of an organisation’s activities, finances or governance quality.
Filing and management run through a separate authenticated area, which was not exercised, so nothing is asserted about it.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-05 from the register’s own portal pages, including its about, legislation and privacy pages. FOUR ROLES, determined separately. LEGAL SOURCE OF RECORD: The register is constituted by the Codice del Terzo settore, decreto legislativo 3 luglio 2017, n. 117: the portal states that it is the telematic register established at the Ministry of Labour and Social Policies in implementation of articles 45 and following of that code. Entries are made territorially by the state, regional and provincial offices of the register, established respectively at the ministry, at each region and at the autonomous provinces of Trento and Bolzano. Procedures for registration, deposit of documents and keeping of the register are set by a ministerial decree numbered 106; the portal and the gazette record differ on that decree’s date, so the date is deliberately not asserted here and the code is cited as the constituting instrument instead. RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY: Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali, which the portal’s privacy notice names as data controller for the register portal and at which the register is established. TECHNICAL PLATFORM: Not established. No supplier is named on any page fetched, and none is asserted. PUBLIC ACCESS INTERFACE: The public portal at servizi.lavoro.gov.it/runts, which offers an entity search and downloadable entity lists alongside a separate authenticated area for filings. Registry type: charity-register, because registration confers or evidences third sector status, which is what the type requires; the boundary note excluding a general company register that happens to include non-profit forms is what keeps this separate from the Italian business register already published. This portal is on a ministry host and shares no hostname with any published Italian record.

name: Albi ed elenchi di vigilanza
description: Banca d’Italia publishes the supervisory registers and lists of banks and other financial intermediaries. It states that publication discharges the public-information duties imposed by the Italian banking and financial consolidated acts, and the published data extends beyond the registers themselves to registration and cancellation dates, activities and branches.

publicAccess.notes: The public consultation application was reached anonymously and served without any credential once a session cookie was accepted, which is a meaningful contrast with the separate insurance supervisor’s portal that redirects to a one-time-password login. No query was executed, so no search behaviour, fee or limit is asserted and no search URL is published.

bestFor: Checking whether a bank or financial intermediary is entered in the Italian supervisory registers, and when it was entered or cancelled.
Reading the activities and branches recorded for a supervised intermediary, which the publication carries beyond the bare register entries.
notRecommendedFor: Insurance undertakings and intermediaries, which are supervised by the insurance authority and are not in these registers.
Treating entry as a statement about an intermediary’s soundness. It records authorisation and registration, not condition.
recommendedIndustries: Banks and financial intermediaries supervised in Italy
pros: The supervisor states that publication discharges a statutory public-information duty, so the register is published as an obligation rather than as a courtesy.
The publication deliberately carries more than the bare register — registration and cancellation dates, activities and branches — and supports historical searching.
It makes a legally consequential fact checkable: carrying on banking or financial activity without the required entry is a criminal offence in Italy.
cons: The consultation application is client-rendered and was not exercised, so its search behaviour, export options and any limits were not observed.
It covers banking and financial intermediaries. Insurance and securities populations sit with other authorities, and absence here says nothing about them.
Entry records authorisation and registration. It is not a statement about solvency, conduct or the quality of any service.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-06 by navigating from the supervisor’s own supervision pages, and re-verified in a separate direct adversarial pass. The supervisor’s own words: “Con la pubblicazione degli "Albi ed elenchi di vigilanza" la Banca d’Italia ottempera agli obblighi informativi nei confronti del pubblico previsti dai Testi Unici in materia di intermediazione bancaria e finanziaria”, and “L’esercizio di attività bancaria o finanziaria in mancanza delle autorizzazioni/iscrizioni ai pertinenti albi previste dalla legge è sanzionato penalmente.” FOUR ROLES, determined separately. LEGAL SOURCE OF RECORD: The supervisory registers themselves, kept by Banca d’Italia under the Italian banking and financial consolidated acts. The registers are the instrument; the published consultation is the window onto them. RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY: Banca d’Italia. TECHNICAL PLATFORM: The supervisor’s own statistical information platform hosts the public consultation application. No external supplier is named on any page fetched. PUBLIC ACCESS INTERFACE: The public consultation of supervisory registers and lists of banks and other intermediaries, reached from the supervisor’s own pages. A quotation correction made during the second direct adversarial pass and worth recording: the criminal-sanction sentence was first transcribed with a straight apostrophe, which is not what the page serves. The page uses a typographic apostrophe, and the quotation was corrected rather than published as approximate. Scoping: the insurance supervisor’s portal is a separate system on a separate host and is NOT covered here; it redirects to a one-time-password login and remains unpublished pending an open access route.

name: Albo Nazionale dei Dottori Commercialisti e degli Esperti Contabili
description: The national roll of Italian chartered accountants and accounting experts, published by the national council over the rolls kept by the territorial Ordini. It searches individual members, professional companies and declared services from one roll.
englishName: National Roll of Chartered Accountants and Accounting Experts

operator.name: Consiglio Nazionale dei Dottori Commercialisti e degli Esperti Contabili

publicAccess.notes: The roll and its three searches were served anonymously with no credential, so login is recorded as not required. The search interfaces render with JavaScript and no query was executed, so result content, coverage and any limits were not observed and stay null.

bestFor: Checking that a named accountant is on the Italian national roll.
Checking a professional company as well as an individual member.
notRecommendedFor: Raising an individual matter with the national council. It answers only territorial Ordini and public bodies.
Judging an accountant’s quality from a declared service. Declared services are not verified statements of expertise.
pros: It searches members, professional companies and declared services from a single national roll rather than 131 separate ones.
The national council states its own remit, citing article 29 of legislative decree 139/2005.
The roll’s scale is published on the council’s own page: 131 territorial Ordini and almost 120,000 members.
cons: Entry on the roll is required to use the professional titles and to carry out the profession’s reserved activities, but an entry is not a statement about the quality of any engagement.

The national council publishes the roll; the underlying rolls are kept by the 131 territorial Ordini, and the council states that requests from individuals must go to the territorially competent Ordine.
The three searches — members, companies and services — are views of one roll, not three registers, so a result in one does not imply absence from another.
The declared-services search reflects what a member has declared, not an assessment by the council or by an Ordine.
The search interfaces render with JavaScript, so they could not be exercised and nothing about result content or coverage is asserted.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-06 by direct fetch of the national roll page and its member search, and re-verified in a separate direct adversarial pass. The council states: "Interlocutori del Consiglio nazionale dei Dottori Commercialisti ed Esperti Contabili sono i 131 Ordini territoriali della categoria, i quasi 120.000 iscritti all’Albo, le Istituzioni e le pubbliche amministrazioni, i media", and that "Il CNDCEC, quale organo nazionale, risponde esclusivamente alle richieste formulate dagli Ordini territoriali e da altri enti ed istituzioni pubbliche, relative alle materie rientranti tra le sue attribuzioni (art. 29, d.lgs. 139/2005). Le richieste dei singoli (iscritti, tirocinanti o aspiranti tali) vanno indirizzate all’Ordine territorialmente competente." FOUR ROLES, determined separately. LEGAL SOURCE OF RECORD: The rolls kept by the 131 territorial Ordini; the national council publishes the national aggregate. RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY: Consiglio Nazionale dei Dottori Commercialisti e degli Esperti Contabili. TECHNICAL PLATFORM: Not separately established. Served from the council’s own commercialisti.it domain. PUBLIC ACCESS INTERFACE: The national roll and its three searches at commercialisti.it/albo-nazionale/. Duplicate decision: "Ricerca Iscritti", "Ricerca Società" and "Ricerca Prestazioni" are three views of ONE albo published under a single "Albo Nazionale" heading, not three registers. Splitting them would split a system by its own filters.

name: Albo Unico dei notai — Trova Notaio
description: The single electronic professional roll of Italian notaries, published by the National Council of Notaries under article 3 of Presidential Decree 137 of 7 August 2012. The territorial Ordini and the notaries themselves enter the data; the national council states that it cannot alter it.
englishName: Single Electronic Professional Roll of Notaries

publicAccess.notes: The search was served anonymously with no credential, with a region selector covering all twenty Italian regions, so login is recorded as not required. The page instructs a reader not to enter the notary’s name. No query was executed, so result content, coverage and any limits were not observed and stay null.

bestFor: Finding notaries by Italian region from the single national roll.
Establishing that the roll exists on a stated statutory basis rather than as an association directory.
notRecommendedFor: Searching by a notary’s name. The page explicitly instructs a reader not to enter it.
Any marketing or commercial use of the data, which the council states is a pursuable offence.
pros: Its statutory basis is stated on the page itself: the single electronic professional roll under article 3 of D.P.R. 137 of 7 August 2012.
It covers all twenty Italian regions, from Abruzzo to Veneto including the autonomous regions.
The council is explicit about provenance, stating that entries are inserted by the territorial Ordini and by the notaries themselves.
cons: Entry on the roll is required to practise as a notary, but an entry is not a statement about how any deed was drawn or any transaction handled.
The search is organised by region and the page instructs a reader NOT to enter the notary’s name, so it does not work as a name-verification tool.

The national council states that it cannot make changes or updates to the entries, because the data is inserted by the territorial Ordini and by the notaries; an error therefore has to be corrected at source.
Use of the data for marketing or advertising is stated to be a pursuable offence and incompatible with the purpose for which the data is held, so this is not a source for building contact lists.

Absence from a regional result does not establish that a person is not a notary. The search is organised by region, and because entries are inserted by the territorial Ordini and by the notaries themselves, an entry may not yet reflect a recent change.
No search was executed during verification, so result content, coverage and completeness were not observed and none is asserted.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-06 by navigating from the council’s own site, and re-verified in a separate direct adversarial pass. The page identifies itself as "Albo Unico professionale elettronico – Articolo 3, D.P.R. 7 agosto 2012, n. 137" and states: "Le informazioni degli iscritti vengono inserite nel database dagli Ordini Territoriali e dai Notai. Il CNN non può effettuare variazioni e/o aggiornamenti alle informazioni." It further states that "Costituisce illecito perseguibile l’utilizzazione dei dati degli iscritti per attività di marketing o di invio di pubblicità", and instructs "Non inserire il nome del notaio". FOUR ROLES, determined separately. LEGAL SOURCE OF RECORD: The single electronic professional roll under article 3 of D.P.R. 137/2012, populated by the territorial Ordini and by the notaries themselves. RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY: Consiglio Nazionale del Notariato. TECHNICAL PLATFORM: Not separately established. Served from the council’s own notariato.it domain; a supplier subdomain also resolves to the same functionality and is not recorded as the canonical entry. PUBLIC ACCESS INTERFACE: The Trova Notaio search at notariato.it/it/trova-notaio/. Access observation at verification: the page displayed a notice that extraordinary maintenance was under way and that the Trova Notaio function might be interrupted. That is a transient condition and is not recorded as a permanent limitation, but it is why no query was attempted.

name: PagineGialle
description: The Italian Yellow Pages directory, operated by Italiaonline. Creating a company profile is free but requires an Italian VAT number, and the same Italiaonline self-service system also serves the Virgilio Aziende directory.
bestFor: VAT-registered Italian businesses wanting a free national directory profile.
Reaching two Italiaonline properties through one registration, since Virgilio Aziende uses the same self-service system.
notRecommendedFor: Businesses without an Italian VAT number. The registration page states one is necessary.
Anyone treating Virgilio Aziende as a separate listing opportunity. Its registration routes into this same system.
pros: Creating a profile is free and stated plainly: “Crea gratis il tuo Profilo Azienda”.
The operator is clearly identified as Italiaonline S.p.A. in the site’s legal footer.
The profile is self-managed — the operator promises management “in pochi clic” with hours, photos and posts.
Profiles carry reviews, which the directory advertises in its own title.
cons: An Italian VAT number is required. The registration page carries the condition “*Partita IVA necessaria”, so this is not open to unregistered businesses or to foreign companies without Italian VAT registration.
Supplying a VAT number is a requirement of the form. Whether the operator verifies it against any register is not documented, so no verification method is asserted.
Creating a profile is confirmed; claiming an existing third-party profile is not documented, so no claim flow is asserted.
Reviews appear on profiles, but whether a business can respond to them is not documented and is not asserted.
A profile is a directory entry. It is not evidence that a business is solvent, currently trading, or checked beyond the VAT number the form requires.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-06 from the directory and its own registration page, and re-verified in a separate direct pass in which “Crea gratis il tuo Profilo Azienda” and “Partita IVA necessaria” were both present in the served page. PLATFORM OPERATOR: Italiaonline S.p.A., named in the legal footer of both this directory and Virgilio Aziende. LISTING CONTROL: The business creates and manages its own profile through the Italiaonline self-service system. MODERATION AUTHORITY: Not documented by the operator. PUBLIC INTERFACE: paginegialle.it, with registration at /inserisci_attivita. DUPLICATE DECISION — VIRGILIO AZIENDE ABSORBED: Virgilio Aziende is NOT published as a separate record. Both properties carry the same Italiaonline S.p.A. footer, and Virgilio’s “Registra Azienda Gratis” call to action routes to italiaonline.it/self/pgit — the PagineGialle self-service product — which was confirmed in the served HTML. A business registering through Virgilio is registering in this system, so the two are one listing product surfaced on two properties rather than two independent profiles. This is the opposite conclusion to the Polish WeNet pair, where the same group runs two genuinely separate submission forms. NOT ASSERTED: verification method, owner responses, claim flow, indexability, link attributes, traffic.
